description: Source code for the 'Upgrade' controller class within the OpenCart admin tool namespace, implementing upgrade functionalities such as checking for latest version, downloading, installing, and patching updates.

classes.name: Upgrade
classes.description: Controller class responsible for handling upgrade operations in the OpenCart admin area, including checking for updates, downloading new versions, and applying patches.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the upgrade page with current version, latest version info, and upgrade status.

methods.name: download
methods.description: Handles downloading of a specified OpenCart version zip file from the server or GitHub repository, and prepares for installation.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Manages the installation process, including verifying version compatibility, unzipping files, and applying updates.

methods.name: upgrade
methods.description: Performs the actual upgrade process by fetching latest version info, downloading update files, unzipping, and updating files.
